Excellent Salad Dressing
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 2, 2009 - 12:13am

Ingredients




1 cup virgin olive oil
 cup wine vinegar
2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
1 teaspoon freshly ground pepper
1/2 teaspoon garlic salt (or 1 crushed clove of fresh 
Preparation

1 Variations: Add 1 teaspoon of oregano; add 1 teaspoon of tarragon; fresh herbs work best for Caesar salad; add 3 tablespoons of Parmesan cheese 2 Mix all ingredients in small bowl with whisk. Fresh herbs and garlic make this dressing taste excellent, however, dried herbs and garlic salt will be delicious, too.
